change.description: The GVRs field value type changes from bool to struct{}. This breaks all sites that: (1) create a map literal or make() call typed as map[K]bool and assign it to GVRs, (2) assign boolean values into the map (m[k]=true), (3) iterate and capture the bool value via range. Sites that only check membership using the comma-ok idiom (_, ok := m[k]) remain valid.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: A struct literal initialising GVRs with map[K]bool cannot be assigned to a field of type map[K]struct{}.
A locally created map[K]bool cannot be assigned to the GVRs field (now map[K]struct{}), and ranging over the new map yields struct{} values not bool.

impacted_files.suggested_fix: Change the local variable declaration to map[schema.GroupVersionResource]struct{} and update the assignment inside the loop to filteredGVRs[existingGVR] = struct{}{}. Remove or update any code that reads the boolean value v (it is now a zero-size struct).
Change the gvrMap declaration to map[schema.GroupVersionResource]struct{}, replace gvrMap[gvr] = true with gvrMap[gvr] = struct{}{}, and the GVRs field assignment compiles automatically.
Replace all map[schema.GroupVersionResource]bool{k: true} literals with map[schema.GroupVersionResource]struct{}{k: struct{}{}} in the test table entries.
